name: viewMatS
meaning: fixed-point 4.12 view rotation + translation, rebuilt from rot every frame

name: viewMat
meaning: D3D view matrix; the 4x4 rotation is built from rot and the translation row at +0x70 is set to -(R * worldPos) [typed Mat44 - the static initialiser 0x40103a constructs +0x40 and +0x80 with Mat44_Ctor, so these members have a constructor]

name: viewMatCopy
meaning: The matrix every world-mesh and rigid-instance draw passes to SetTransform(VIEW). Cull_IsAabbVisible transforms corners by +0x80..+0xB8 (row-vector, translation at +0xB0). WorldObj_DrawSky uses a copy with the translation row zeroed. Instan [typed Mat44, constructed by 0x40103a (mov ecx,0x584cd0 = g_camera+0x80)]

name: viewPos
meaning: camera world position transformed through viewMatS

name: planeD
meaning: dot(viewMatS.rot row at +0x0C..+0x10, worldPos) — the view plane constant

name: dist
meaning: Orbit distance from eye to aim point. Written by Camera_SolveCollision (+0xD6 at its end), the fixed look-at and script modes, and Camera_Reset (0x400). Read as the current distance by Camera_SmoothToDesired and the cut logic. Same address as g_camDist 0x584d26. Missing from Camera.csv.
